description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment, Aththidiya South Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map. No. 521002
categorisation: This gazette exclusively concerns a land title registration amendment under the Registration of Title Act. It details a specific amendment to the title register for a particular parcel of land (No. 155 of Block 05) regarding the insertion of a servitude right from an adjacent parcel. The content is entirely focused on land and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
